business_problem: Altruist set out to create a scalable, secure platform to better serve the $10 trillion registered investment advisor market by overcoming the constraints of outdated technology used by legacy custodians.
solution_summary: Altruist built a full-stack, vertically integrated custodial platform on AWS so financial advisors can access a more scalable and secure operating environment. The platform runs core services on Amazon EKS and Amazon RDS, while AWS IAM and AWS CloudTrail help enforce access controls and audit activity. Altruist also uses Amazon EC2 with AWS Graviton processors to improve price-performance. According to the case study, the company can automatically scale resources across regions on demand and maintain highly available databases and clusters while keeping security controls strong. This architecture gives engineers faster test-and-release cycles and lets the firm expand advisor-facing capabilities without relying on legacy custodian infrastructure.

solution_components.name: Amazon EKS
solution_components.role: Runs the core platform services that power Altruist’s vertically integrated custodian.

solution_components.name: Amazon RDS
solution_components.role: Stores the relational data that underpins the advisor platform.

solution_components.name: AWS IAM
solution_components.role: Controls identities and permissions for internal users and workloads.

solution_components.name: AWS CloudTrail
solution_components.role: Captures audit activity so suspicious behavior can be detected and addressed quickly.

solution_components.name: Amazon EC2
solution_components.role: Provides the compute foundation that benefits from AWS Graviton price-performance improvements.
